## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and why it is needed.

## Evidence

List the checks run and any changed security or data boundaries.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Data and examples are synthetic.
- [ ] No secrets, private URLs, local paths, or database files are included.
- [ ] Dependency, lockfile, install-script, and workflow changes are explained.
- [ ] Changed behavior has a focused regression test.
- [ ] No new external services, privileged CI, or deployment is introduced.
